name: What are common accessibility-minded bathroom modifications?

mainEntity.name: What are common accessibility-minded bathroom modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common modifications include installing grab bars near the toilet and in the shower/tub, replacing a traditional tub with a curbless shower, widening doorways for wheelchair access, and adjusting counter and sink heights. Other considerations are comfort-height toilets, non-slip flooring, and improved lighting to enhance safety and usability for individuals with varying mobility needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common modifications include grab bars, curbless showers, wider doorways, and adjusted counter heights for improved accessibility.
